scenes.caption: An aerial photo.
scenes.say: Nabeel studies an aerial photo of a town beside a river.

scenes.caption: A river.
scenes.say: The river gives water, food and a way to travel.

scenes.caption: A bridge.
scenes.say: A bridge at the bend brings roads together.

scenes.caption: Mohenjo-daro.
scenes.say: Mohenjo-daro grew in the same way beside the Indus.

scenes.caption: Manchester.
scenes.say: Manchester grew near rivers and canals that carried goods.

scenes.caption: Growth.
scenes.say: Roads, markets and factories made the place bigger.

scenes.caption: Services.
scenes.say: Schools, clinics and parks followed as people moved in.

scenes.caption: A reason.
scenes.say: Every settlement has reasons for where it grew.
